description: This file defines a service module for a travel assistant application, containing functions to synthesize travel tips based on weather and location data, and to build comprehensive travel advice by fetching data via a backend client.

classes.name: WeatherInfo
classes.description: Model representing weather data including summary, temperature, humidity, wind speed, and optional feels-like temperature.

classes.name: ClothingRecommendation
classes.description: Model representing clothing items and the reasons to wear them.

classes.name: PlaceInfo
classes.description: Model representing information about a place, including name, category, description, and URL.

classes.name: TravelAdvice
classes.description: Composite model containing city, weather, clothing recommendations, places, and tips.

methods.name: List[str] _synthesize_tips(weather: WeatherInfo, clothing: List[ClothingRecommendation], places: List[PlaceInfo])
methods.description: Creates a list of human-readable travel tips based on weather, clothing, and places data.

methods.name: TravelAdvice build_travel_advice(city: str, client: BackendClient)
methods.description: Main function that fetches data from the backend and constructs an integrated TravelAdvice object.
